description: This dataset contains observations of the marine gastropod species Bulla gouldiana, collected from various locations primarily in California, with additional records from Costa Rica and the Galápagos Islands. The data includes taxonomic information such as kingdom, phylum, class, family, genus, and species, along with spatial data like coordinates, coordinate uncertainty, and country codes. Temporal data includes event dates, days, months, and years, allowing for temporal analysis. The dataset also provides attribution details such as the identifiers of those who recorded and identified the species, as well as licensing information. The semantic profile indicates that the data is structured for biodiversity research, with columns serving as aggregation keys, spatial filters, temporal filters, and metadata. This dataset can be used for studying the distribution, habitat preferences, and temporal patterns of Bulla gouldiana, as well as for biodiversity monitoring and conservation efforts.
